name: debalect
description: Debalect — Open-source cognitive training platform with Oxford Union debate opponent and logic professor

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npm run typecheck
